paragraphs.en: {I} {have} a special place in my heart for {libraries} .I was always an {enthusiastic} {reader} , {sometimes} reading up to three books a day as a child.Stories were like {air} to me and while other kids played {ball} or went to parties, I lived out {adventures} through the books I checked out from the library, lost among the pages of stories that took me to far-off ( (遥远的) ) places like the {equator} or ancient {palaces} .The scent of old paper and the quiet {whisper} of turning pages were my favorite.
paragraphs.cn: <u> 图书馆 </u> 在 <u> 我 </u> 心中 <u> 有 </u> 着特殊的位置。我一直是个 <u> 满怀热情的读者 </u> ，小时候 <u> 有时 </u> 一天能读多达三本书。故事对我来说就像 <u> 空气 </u> 一样不可或缺，当其他孩子打 <u> 球 </u> 或参加派对时，我正在从图书馆借来的书中体验着各种 <u> 冒险 </u> ，沉浸在书页中那些把我带到遥远地方的故事里，比如 <u> 赤道 </u> 或古老的 <u> 宫殿 </u> 。旧纸张散发的气味和翻动书页时轻轻的 <u> 沙沙声 </u> 都是我的最爱。

paragraphs.en: My first job was working at the Ukiah Library when I was 16 years old.It was a {dream} job and I did {everything} from {shelving} books to reading to the children for story time.When the {bell} above the library entrance {rang} , it was the start of another day filled with discovery.

paragraphs.en: As I grew older and became a mother, the library took on an {added} meaning in my life.I had several children and books were {our} main source of {entertainment} .It was a big deal for us to {load} up and go to the {local} library.We'd {pack} a picnic with {hamburgers} , {dumplings} , or {pies} , and stroll {downtown} to our favorite library branch, where my kids {could} pick out books to read or books they wanted me to read to {them} .
paragraphs.cn: 随着年岁的增长，我成了一位母亲，图书馆在我的生活中有了 <u> 新的 </u> 意义。我有几个孩子，书籍是 <u> 我们 </u> 主要的 <u> 娱乐 </u> 来源。对我们来说， <u> 装 </u> 好东西去 <u> 当地 </u> 图书馆是一件大事。我们会 <u> 带上 </u> 一份有 <u> 汉堡包 </u> 、 <u> 饺子 </u> ，或 <u> 馅饼 </u> 的野餐，然后漫步到 <u> 市中心 </u> 那家我们最喜欢的图书馆分馆。在那里，我的孩子们 <u> 可以 </u> 挑选想读的书，或者想让我读给 <u> 他们 </u> 听的书。

paragraphs.en: After having the picnic food for lunch, I read stories about {dragons} , {whales} , and adventures.I used different voices, as though I were {acting} out the stories {with} my voice and they loved it! We would draw scenes from stories with {crayons} , making it a special time to {bond} with my children and it {filled} them with the {wonderment} of books.
paragraphs.cn: 午饭吃完野餐的食物后，我会给孩子们读关于 <u> 龙 </u> 、 <u> 鲸鱼 </u> 和冒险的故事。我会使用不同的声音，仿佛 <u> 用 </u> 声音 <u> 表演 </u> 故事一样，他们很喜欢！我们会用 <u> 蜡笔 </u> 画出故事中的场景，这是与孩子们建立 <u> 联系 </u> 的特殊时光，也让他们对书籍 <u> 充满 </u> 了 <u> 惊奇 </u> 。

paragraphs.en: As a {novelist} , I've found a new {relationship} with libraries.I encourage readers to go to their local library {when} their {budget} is limited and can't {afford} to {purchase} a book.I see libraries as a {safe} haven ( (避风港) ) for readers and writers, a {bridge} that helps put {together} a reader with a book.My favorite library is a {noble} building with {gray} stone walls and tall {columns} that reach toward the sky.I remember the kind {librarian} , {Mrs.} Brown, who has dedicated {nineteen} years of her life to preserving the treasures within its walls.She organized gatherings at the library's grand {hall} , which attracted even the local {council} workers.Libraries, in their own way, help {fight} book piracy ( (盗版行为) ) and I think all writers should support libraries in a significant way when {they} can.Encourage readers to use the library. {Share} library announcements {on} your {website} and social media. {Frequent} them and talk about them when you can.
paragraphs.cn: 作为一名 <u> 小说家 </u> ，我发现自己与图书馆建立了一种新的 <u> 关系 </u> 。 <u> 当 </u> 读者 <u> 预算 </u> 有限、 <u> 买不起 </u> 书 <u> 时 </u> ，我就鼓励他们去当地图书馆。我把图书馆视为读者和作家的 <u> 安全 </u> 避风港，是将读者与书籍联系在 <u> 一起 </u> 的 <u> 桥梁 </u> 。我最喜欢的图书馆是一座 <u> 宏伟的 </u> 建筑，有着 <u> 灰色的 </u> 石墙和高耸入云的 <u> 柱子 </u> 。我至今记得那位和蔼可亲的 <u> 图书管理员 </u> 布朗 <u> 夫人 </u> ，她将自己人生中的 <u> 十九 </u> 年奉献给了保护馆内的珍贵藏书。她在图书馆的大 <u> 厅 </u> 组织聚会，甚至吸引了当地 <u> 市政 </u> 工作人员前来参加。图书馆以自己的方式助力 <u> 打击 </u> 盗版行为，我认为，所有作家都应该在 <u> 他们 </u> 力所能及的范围内大力支持图书馆的工作。鼓励读者使用图书馆。在你们的 <u> 网站 </u> 和社交媒体 <u> 上分享 </u> 图书馆的公告。尽可能 <u> 经常去 </u> 图书馆，并谈论它们。 5NoOncib/NjiX02BpMIzP+Fxyt/ox+WDCb+dhfH7KaYaJ4u5RsVmLondVmcHiLum9J1BQErGzJvzqa5GEIz4ZA==
